images.alt: Галапагосский альбатрос на низком скалистом побережье Эспаньолы — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Create one premium travel website hero, wide landscape 16:9, photorealistic editorial illustration of Espanola island in the Galapagos, Ecuador, near Punta Suarez. One anatomically accurate adult waved albatross standing on a flat coastal volcanic rock at right foreground: large yellow bill, creamy pale head and neck, dark brown finely waved body feather pattern, realistic webbed feet and folded wings. Low dry coastal grasses and weathered lava terrain, rugged dark coast with white surf and broad deep blue Pacific in background, a few very small distant marine birds. The island is low and arid, no towering volcano, no palm trees. Soft natural equatorial afternoon light, refined wildlife travel photography aesthetic, respectful distance, truthful species anatomy, generous open sea and sky on left for title, no people, no text, watermarks, logos or montage.
